feeds.title: Savings 4 Savvy Mums
feeds.description: A website for mums who want to save their family money day to day, eat a better range of food for less and make money saving simple; to show that it is possible to achieve your financial goals on a budget.

feeds.title: Emma and 3 Saves | Saving Tips
feeds.description: Saving You Money. Mums Savvy Savings is my new venture. I like the good things things in life, along with the rest of the family and in order to have that I need to be savvy. Therefore this blog will document how I am saving money but still living the good life.

feeds.title: Money Nuggets
feeds.description: Money Nuggets is a personal finance and career advice blog for women who want to take charge of their finances, achieve their financial goals and secure their future. Its mission is to empower women through financial education.

feeds.title: Confessions of a Single Mum | Money
feeds.description: The ups, the downs and sideways views of life as a single parent with money saving tips.
